title: Different needs combine amid the unknown

captions.energy: Seeking a combination of different needs

meaning: Shared action amid incomplete information to combine needs is emotionally expressed through a gradual sense of different responses finding room beside each other.
text: The Moon in the physical position of this Energy Field concerns shared actions amid incomplete information: you compare impressions and try accounts without a clear picture. Temperance in energy motivates combining different needs. In emotions, the same Temperance brings the experience of differences gradually coming together. Wanting to recognise difference and emotionally feeling relief occupy different roles. Repetition requires no doubled patience: you can seek a suitable proportion and feel more room together while reasons for inconvenience remain unclear. Calm establishes no facts about another person’s wishes and makes no midpoint permanently compulsory.

For example, you try different forms of shared leisure without fully understanding why earlier evenings became tiring. Wanting room for both requests helps combine a walk, separate time and conversation. Gradually, different rhythms interfere less with being beside each other. **We seek a combination of needs and feel responses finding a common place.** Emotional coexistence proves neither complete clarity nor an identical wish to repeat this exact sequence in future. A useful attempt can remain provisional.

Harmony becomes a demand if it prohibits another inconvenience. Temporary relief turns into a rigid rule, while the incomplete picture stops being clarified. Temperance’s two roles require no permanent acceptance of compromise. The Moon confirms no guesses. Shared practice can preserve room for the unknown and different feelings, allowing changes to scale, proportions of involvement and the explanation of what currently suits each person. Feeling more settled does not have to close further practical questions.
